description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'SkillServiceTest' that tests the 'SkillService' class in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes test methods for CRUD operations and search functionality related to skills, utilizing mocks for dependencies and loading test fixtures.

classes.name: SkillServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the functionality of SkillService methods such as delete, retrieve, save, and search Skills within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of SkillService, and populates test fixtures from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDeleteSkill
methods.description: Tests the deletion of skills via SkillService, verifying correct interaction with SkillDao mock.

methods.name: testGetSkillById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a skill by ID, confirming correct data returned from the service.

methods.name: testSaveSkill
methods.description: Tests saving a new skill object and expects it to be returned correctly.

methods.name: testSearchSkill
methods.description: Tests searching for skills using filter parameters, verifying the list of skills returned.

methods.name: testGetSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Tests obtaining the count of skills matching certain search criteria.
